additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367367-DC/Si-D/FI-[4AHFi9]-QA9-10 and both main unit CableTempIssue CRM:00315001560
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
A quick update on the CableTempSensor error. From our perspective, I cannot recommend to replace a cable with more than 10 occurrences, this was aligned with Product Champion as it would be massive in costs. First we need to make an assessment of the plug and go from there. It's up to you if you want to take a spare one or not, for the ones that have few occurrences, since (in this case) it occurred only once/twice per week (for all outlets). I would suggest to make some visual inspection first
In sum, from TechSupport:
Cannot recommend to bring a cable
Replace QA09-10
Thank you for understanding.
Best regards,
Francisco
